title: PostReady: PR #495 — Video reframe Phase 2a: persist per-platform offsets on save
description: Reframe offsets now persist per-platform when saved, so users's framing choices are remembered across sessions. Merged Jul 12.

title: PostReady: PR #494 — Auto-caption videos by captioning an extracted frame
description: Video uploads now auto-generate captions using vision on an extracted frame, reducing manual caption entry for uploaded video content. Merged Jul 12.

title: PostReady: PR #493 — Video reframe: pause/play, scrub bar, copy-framing-to-all
description: Added pause/play controls (with auto-pause on drag), a scrub bar for navigating video frames, and a copy-framing-to-all button for efficient multi-platform setup. Merged Jul 12.

title: PostReady: PR #492 — Length coach: redirect long-form videos to YouTube
description: Added a length coach that detects long-form video uploads and guides users toward YouTube, reinforcing that ZippityOne is short-form first. Merged Jul 12.

title: PostReady: PR #491 — Video reframe Phase 1: per-platform offsets + available for generated videos
description: Added per-platform reframe offsets so generated videos are automatically repositioned for each target platform (e.g. portrait TikTok vs landscape YouTube). Also surfaced the reframe tool on already-generated videos. Merged Jul 12.

title: PostReady: PR #490 — Fix: guarantee X posts fit 280 chars (trim at publish + generate to fit)
description: X/Twitter rejects posts over 280 chars for non-Premium accounts. Fixed with a hard trim at publish time and a generate-to-fit mode so ZippityOne captions never exceed the limit. Merged Jul 12.

title: PostReady: PR #489 — Fix: stop wide/vertical outpaint from adding a picture frame
description: Bug fix: prevented the wide/vertical outpaint mode from wrapping generated images in an unwanted picture frame. Merged Jul 12.

title: PostReady: PR #488 — Prompt Studio: reference-image upload (vision) + editable crafted prompt
description: Prompt Studio now accepts a reference image via vision API to inform prompt crafting, and the crafted prompt is fully editable before use. Merged Jul 11.

title: PostReady: PR #487 — Landing: 'Built for businesses and creators' + creators in audience list
description: Updated landing headline to 'Built for businesses and creators' and added creators to the audience strip. Broader positioning. Merged Jul 11.

title: PostReady: PR #486 — Video preview: drag-to-reframe within overscan buffer
description: Added drag-to-reframe UX in video preview — users can pan within an overscan buffer to choose the crop before finalizing. Merged Jul 11.
